pricing.title: Built for Serious Admission Operations.
pricing.description: Complete admission system with unlimited usage. Only user count and WhatsApp alerts differ by plan.
pricing.positioningLine: One admission pays for the system.
pricing.unlimitedUsageLine: All plans include unlimited leads, students, courses, enquiries, follow-ups, and notes.
pricing.unlimitedUsageHint: Only user count and WhatsApp alerts differ by plan.
pricing.trialBadge: 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
pricing.whatsAppAlertsTooltip: Operational notifications automatically sent by the system through WhatsApp. These alerts help institutes stay informed about enquiries and follow-ups without checking the dashboard constantly.
pricing.whatsAppAutoLine1: Alerts are sent automatically by the system. Message limits apply per institute account.
pricing.whatsAppAutoLine2: Daily limits help maintain reliable delivery and prevent message abuse.
pricing.whatsAppExtraLine: Extra alerts are billed per message according to your plan.
pricing.coreSystemLine: Core workflows stay complete across all plans. No artificial feature gating.
pricing.whatsAppSenderModesLine: WhatsApp alerts can be sent using the OnCampus system number or your institute's own WhatsApp Business number.
pricing.starterFeature1: Public institute page with courses + enquiry
pricing.starterFeature3: Unlimited lead capture (website, QR, shared links)
pricing.starterFeature8: Single-user access with optional custom WhatsApp number
pricing.starterOutcome: I run admissions in a structured, professional way without hiring extra staff.

pricing.growthOutcome: My admission team works in sync. No missed follow-ups. Faster conversions.
pricing.scaleFeature5: No OnCampus branding on institute admission pages
pricing.scaleFeature6: Suitable for large admission teams and multi-counsellor workflows
pricing.scaleFeature9: Lead and student operations at scale
pricing.scaleOutcome: We operate like a professional admission machine.
pricing.addonsDescription: Add-ons expand capability without forcing unnecessary upgrades.
pricing.annualLine1: Switch to Yearly and pay only 10 months for full-year access.
pricing.annualLine2: Professional annual billing for better savings and commitment.
pricing.trust9: Operational alerts delivered via secure WhatsApp integration.
pricing.roiLine1: If average student fee is ₹30,000, Starter at ₹999 is 30x ROI from one additional admission.
pricing.roiLine2: Long-term model is stable, trustworthy, and scalable with no future pricing regret.
pricing.faq1Question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
pricing.faq1Answer: Yes, you can upgrade any time from billing settings inside your dashboard.
pricing.faq2Question: What happens if I exceed my user limit?
pricing.faq2Answer: Adding new users requires an upgrade. All existing operations continue uninterrupted.
pricing.faq3Answer: Yes. Every account includes a 14-day free trial. No credit card is required to start.
pricing.faq4Answer: OnCampus sends automatic WhatsApp alerts to help institutes respond quickly to enquiries and follow-ups. For example: new enquiry notifications, follow-up reminders, and important operational updates. Alerts can use the OnCampus shared number or your institute's connected WhatsApp number, and every alert still counts toward your plan's monthly alert limit.
pricing.supportItem4: WhatsApp support during working hours (Mon–Sat, 10 AM – 7 PM)

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Yes. You can start a free trial before choosing a paid plan.
faq.a2: Yes. You can cancel subscription from billing settings any time.
faq.a3: Yes. Payments are processed securely using Razorpay.
faq.a4: OnCampus uses authenticated access and scoped institute workspaces for data safety.
faq.a5: Yes. Team plans support multiple users with role-based access.
faq.q6: Do you handle student fee payments?
faq.a6: Yes. You can track fee collections and payment records inside OnCampus. Student fee payments are recorded manually with payment method and reference.
